attacks.name: Strike
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
If an allied |*Multiple Man Duplicates| is within |!range| 2 of the defender during the |*Modify Dice| step, this character may reroll up to 2 of its attack dice.

attacks.name: Madrox Monkey Pile!
steps: If an allied |*Multiple Man Duplicates| is within |!range| 2 of the defender during the |*Create Attack Dice Pool| step, add 2 dice to this attack roll.
|!wild| |!hit| |*Stagger|: After this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§stagger§Stagger| special condition.

superPowers.name: X-Factor Investigations (Affiliation: X-Factor)
superPowers.body: During the |*Power Phase|, each allied character Contesting a Secure objective token gains 1 |!power|.|\|Additionally, when an allied character rolls dice when Interacting with an objective token, it may reroll 1 die.

superPowers.name: Duplicate Reabsorption
superPowers.body: Choose an allied |*Multiple Man Duplicates| within |!range| 3 of this character. Move up to 1 Extract objective token being held by the chosen character to this character. This character cannot hold more tokens than the Crisis specifies. Then the chosen character is KO'd and this character removes up to 3 |!damage| from itself. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Follow the Leads
superPowers.body: Throw this character |!movement_small|. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Kinetic Duplication
superPowers.body: When this character suffers |!damage|, after the effect is resolved, if there is not an allied |*Multiple Man Duplicates| in play and this character is not Dazed, Place an allied |*Multiple Man Duplicates| into play within |!range| 2 of this character. It is part of your Squad.

superPowers.name: Shared Experiences
superPowers.body: When an allied |*Multiple Man Duplicates| within |!range| 3 deals |!damage| or suffers |!damage| from an enemy effect, this character gains 1 |!power|.
